title: Strict descent data for augmented module complexes
statement: Let $(C,J,R)$ be a small ringed site, $U:A\to C$ a family, $B$ an $R$-module cochain complex, $L_i$ complexes on $C/U_i$, and $\alpha_i:L_i\to B|_{U_i}$ chain maps [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Strict augmented descent data consist of $R(W)$-linear equivalences $L_i^n(W\to U_i)\simeq L_j^n(W\to U_j)$ for every common test span, natural under every further test map, satisfying the triple cocycle and commuting with differentials and $\alpha_i$. This is the complex version of the all-test-span formulation [def-weil-pbc-site-module-compatible-tuples]; it assumes no fibre products.

structure AugmentedComplexGlueData (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{u}) {A : Type u} (U : A → C)
    [∀ i, (overFunctor R (U i)).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (B : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} R) ℤ)
    (localComplex : ∀ i : A, CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over (U i))) ℤ)
    (localAugmentation : ∀ i : A,
      localComplex i ⟶ ((overFunctor R (U i)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj B)
